9: const { zombie, imp, demon, baron } = C.ENEMIES;
10: 
11: export function createEnemies(scene, map, hooks) {
12:   const list = [];
13: 
14:   const geo = {
15:     zombie: buildZombieGeo(),
16:     imp: buildImpGeo(),
17:     demon: buildDemonGeo(),
18:     baron: buildBaronGeo(),

21:   function buildZombieGeo() {

26:     head.position.y = 1.45;
27:     g.add(body, head);
28:     return g;
29:   }

31:   function buildImpGeo() {
32:     const g = new THREE.Group();
33:     const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.9, 0.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: imp.color }));
34:     body.position.y = 0.9;
35:     const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.34, 0.3), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xa04a35 }));
36:     head.position.y = 1.55;
37:     const hornL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, 0.25, 4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xccaa66 }));
38:     hornL.position.set(-0.12, 1.85, 0.05);
39:     const hornR = hornL.clone();
40:     hornR.position.x = 0.12;
41:     g.add(body, head, hornL, hornR);
42:     return g;
43:   }
44: 
45:   function buildDemonGeo() {
46:     const g = new THREE.Group();
47:     const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.8, 0.6, 0.45), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: demon.color }));
48:     body.position.y = 0.55;
49:     const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.4, 0.35), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xc04080 }));
50:     head.position.set(0, 1.1, 0.1);
51:     const jaw = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.12, 0.3), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xe080b0 }));
52:     jaw.position.set(0, 0.85, 0.3);
53:     g.add(body, head, jaw);
54:     return g;
55:   }
56: 
57:   function buildBaronGeo() {
58:     const g = new THREE.Group();
59:     const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 1.1, 0.45), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: baron.color }));
60:     body.position.y = 1.1;
61:     const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.45, 0.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x3a8a44 }));
62:     head.position.y = 1.85;
63:     const hL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.4, 4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xddcc88 }));
64:     hL.position.set(-0.15, 2.25, 0.02);
65:     const hR = hL.clone();
66:     hR.position.x = 0.15;
67:     g.add(body, head, hL, hR);
68:     return g;
69:   }

71:   function spawnFromMap() {
72:     for (const e of map.enemies) {
73:       const cfg = C.ENEMIES[e.type];
74:       const mesh = geo[e.type].clone();
75:       mesh.position.set(e.x, 0, e.z);
76:       mesh.visible = true;
77:       scene.add(mesh);
78:       list.push({
79:         type: e.type, x: e.x, z: e.z, y: 0,
80:         hp: cfg.hp,
81:         speed: cfg.speed,
82:         state: 'idle',
83:         cooldown: Math.random() * 1,
84:         facing: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
85:         mesh,
86:         dead: false,
87:         aggroed: false,
88:         flashT: 0,
89:       });
90:     }
91:   }
92: 
93:   const R = (lo, hi) => lo + Math.random() * (hi - lo);
94: 
95:   function damageEnemy(en, dmg) {
96:     if (en.dead) return;
97:     en.hp -= dmg;
98:     en.flashT = 0.08;
99:     if (en.hp <= 0) {
100:       en.dead = true;
101:       en.mesh.visible = false;
102:       hooks.onKill(en, en.x, en.z);
103:     } else if (!en.aggroed) {
104:       en.aggroed = true; // dano sempre aggra
105:       en.state = 'chase';
106:     }
107:   }
108: 
109:   function fireball(en) {
110:     const pl = hooks.getPlayer();
111:     const dx = pl.x - en.x, dz = pl.z - en.z;
112:     hooks.spawnFireball(en.x, en.y + 1.4, en.z, dx, dz, 'enemy');
113:   }
114: 
115:   function hitscanZombie(en) {
116:     const pl = hooks.getPlayer();
117:     const dx = pl.x - en.x, dz = pl.z - en.z;
118:     const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
119:     if (d > 0.01 && !hasLOS(map, Math.floor(en.z), Math.floor(en.x), Math.floor(pl.z), Math.floor(pl.x))) return false;
120:     hooks.damagePlayer(R(zombie.damageMin, zombie.damageMax));
121:     return true;
122:   }
123: 
124:   function update(dt) {
125:     const pl = hooks.getPlayer();
126:     for (const en of list) {
127:       if (en.dead) continue;
128:       en.flashT -= dt;
129:       if (en.mesh.material && en.flashT > 0) en.mesh.material.color.setHex(0xffffff);
130:       else if (en.mesh.children?.[0]?.material && en.flashT > 0) en.mesh.children[0].material.color.setHex(0xffffff);
131:       else if (en.mesh.children?.[0]?.material) en.mesh.children[0].material.color.setHex(en.type === 'zombie' ? zombie.color : en.type === 'imp' ? imp.color : en.type === 'demon' ? demon.color : baron.color);
132: 
133:       const cfg = C.ENEMIES[en.type];
134:       const d = dist2D(en.x, en.z, pl.x, pl.z);
135:       const hasLOSEnemy = hasLOS(map, Math.floor(en.z), Math.floor(en.x), Math.floor(pl.z), Math.floor(pl.x));
136: 
137:       if (!en.aggroed) {
138:         if (d < C.PLAYER.aggroRange && hasLOSEnemy) {
139:           en.aggroed = true;
140:           en.state = 'chase';
141:         }
142:         continue;
143:       }
144: 
145:       en.cooldown -= dt;
146:       en.facing = Math.atan2(pl.z - en.z, pl.x - en.x);
147: 
148:       if (en.type === 'demon') {
149:         if (d > cfg.rangeMax) { moveToward(en, pl, dt); }
150:         else if (en.cooldown <= 0) {
151:           en.cooldown = cfg.cooldown;
152:           hooks.damagePlayer(R(cfg.damage, cfg.damage));
153:           hooks.meleeImpact(en.x, en.z);
154:         }
155:         continue;
156:       }
157: 
158:       if (d > cfg.rangeMax) {
159:         moveToward(en, pl, dt);
160:       } else if (d >= cfg.rangeMin && en.cooldown <= 0) {
161:         en.cooldown = cfg.cooldown;
162:         if (en.type === 'zombie') hitscanZombie(en);
163:         else if (en.type === 'imp') fireball(en);
164:         else if (en.type === 'baron') {
165:           fireball(en);
166:           setTimeout(() => { if (!en.dead) fireball(en); }, 250);
167:         }
168:       } else if (d < cfg.rangeMin) {
169:         moveToward(en, pl, dt);
170:       }
171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   function moveToward(en, pl, dt) {
175:     const cfg = C.ENEMIES[en.type];
176:     const dx = pl.x - en.x, dz = pl.z - en.z;
177:     const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
178:     const nx = en.x + dx / d * cfg.speed * dt;
179:     const nz = en.z + dz / d * cfg.speed * dt;
180:     if (circleFree(map, nx, en.z, 0.35)) en.x = nx;
181:     if (circleFree(map, en.x, nz, 0.35)) en.z = nz;
182:     en.mesh.position.set(en.x, en.y, en.z);
183:     en.mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dz, dx);
184:   }
185: 
186:   spawnFromMap();
187: 
188:   return {
189:     list,
190:     update,
191:     damageEnemy,
192:     get count() { return list.filter((e) => !e.dead).length; },
193:   };
194: }
195: 
196: export default createEnemies;
